mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_approval (id, user_id, recipient, subject, content, expires_at) VALUES (CAST(#{id} AS uuid), CAST(#{userId} AS uuid), #{to}, #{subject}, #{content}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '10' MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, recipient, subject, content, status, expires_at, created_at, updated_at FROM email_approval WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid)
mapper.update: UPDATE email_approval SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE email_approval SET status = 'SENDING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE email_approval SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE email_approval SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND status = 'SENDING'
